titel: In the Monastery Ruins at Night
text: You lie on the flagstones in the nave of a ruined monastery. The vault has collapsed; above you, the night sky between high walls. Outside it rains softly, wind whistles through an empty window, drops fall onto the stone, two owls call to each other. Sometimes pigeons burst up from the masonry, a bell tolls far across the valley – and once, singing drifts over from far away.

gruppen.name: regen
gruppen.text: Soft rain beyond the walls and over the open ruin.

gruppen.name: raum
gruppen.text: The silence of the empty space – so quiet you feel it more than hear it.

gruppen.name: wind
gruppen.text: Wind brushing over the tops of the walls, stronger in gusts.

gruppen.name: fenster
gruppen.text: In a window arch high up on the left, the wind whistles when a gust comes.

gruppen.name: tropfen
gruppen.text: Here and there a drop falls from the wall onto the flagstones – each in a different place.

gruppen.name: kauz
gruppen.text: Outside, two tawny owls call to each other – now left, now right, now further away.

gruppen.name: tauben
gruppen.text: Twice per loop, pigeons start up in the masonry and flutter over you into the sky.

gruppen.name: glocke
gruppen.text: Once per loop a bell tolls far across the valley; the sound echoes back from the slopes several times.

gruppen.name: gesang
gruppen.text: Exactly once, singing drifts over from a monastery beyond the valley – so faint you are not sure you really heard it.

drehbuch: Singing drifts over from far away.
Drizzle; two owls call to each other.
A gust – the empty window whistles, pigeons start up in the masonry.
The rain gets heavier; more drops fall onto the stone inside.
The wind dies down; far across the valley a bell tolls.
